pages.text: Bread crumbs piled on the wooden table outside the shop. Gugu saw them first.
Gugu wanted to eat as many as possible. "These are all mine."
Nono and Kiki came. Gugu swept all the crumbs together with both hands.
Gugu stuffed the beak full of crumbs. Cheeks puffed out.
Gugu waddled over the snow. Crumbs fell one by one.
Under Gugu's feet, fallen crumbs were crushed into powder, out of sight.
Now not one remained in Gugu's beak. The tummy rumbled.
Grandpa Badger asked, "Once your beak is full, what comes next?"
Grandpa served crumbs on a wide plate. Gugu called Nono and Kiki.
All three stood together at the plate and pecked. They finished without spilling a crumb.
